program.description: A powerful devkit for scaffolding new projects.
program.verbose_option: Enable verbose logging for detailed output

version.description: Output the current version of the CLI.

command.description: Create a new project from a template

language.argument: The programming language of the template (e.g., 'react', 'node')

name.argument: The name of your new project

option.description: The name of the template to use (e.g., 'ts', 'simple-api')

command.description: List all available templates in the configuration.

language.argument: The language to filter templates by

mode.option: Set the display mode: 'tree' or 'table'. (Default: tree)

where.option:
Filter templates by property using the format <property>:<value>.

Filters use case-insensitive substring matching (e.g., 'desc:vue').
Use '*' for present (non-empty) and '~' for missing (empty) values.

Example: 'pm:bun alias:* cache:~' (AND logic)

options.global: List templates from the global configuration.
options.local: List templates from the local configuration.
options.all: List templates from both local and global configurations.

interactive.prompt_action: What would you like to configure?

command.description:
Set one or more configuration values. 

Available keys:
  pm, packageManager      - Sets the default package manager to use for new projects.
                          Possible values: {pmValues}
  cache, cacheStrategy    - Sets the global caching behavior for remote templates.
                          Possible values: 'always-refresh', 'never-refresh', 'daily'
  language, lg            - Sets the language of the CLI. Possible values: 'en', 'fr'

argument.description: A list of key-value pairs to set (e.g., 'pm npm language fr')

option.global: Update the global configuration instead of the local one.

command.description: Get one or more configuration values.

argument.description: The key of the configuration value to get (e.g., 'pm', 'language').
